description: List currently rendered discussion threads from a Product Hunt Topic Forum or Product Forum. The default forum is general; use detailed mode for bounded card text and engagement values. No login is required.

parameters.name: forum
parameters.description: Product Hunt Topic Forum or Product Forum slug, such as general or openai.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of currently rendered threads to return; integer from 1 through 50.

parameters.name: detailed
parameters.description: Include bounded card text and raw engagement values; pass true or false.
